title: Five megatrends incl. physical climate change, 2026-2045
disclosures: CLIMATE: damages are a DICE-2023 / Howard-Sterner quadratic OUTPUT loss with regional multipliers (plus a tipping-point term in climate-cascade). The model has no public budget line for adaptation, disaster relief or insurance backstops, no insurance sector and no property market. Q3's fiscal quantity is therefore NOT in the model; only the size of the output loss is.

COVERAGE (C4, Q6 growth leg): OECD-38 + China is read as us + oecd-ex-us + china. The region tables are calibrated to OECD aggregates, but the nine-region split cannot reproduce OECD-38 membership exactly; treat the reading as an OECD-core + China aggregate.
PER CAPITA: the adapter reports GDP and population growth separately. Per-capita growth = (1 + g_GDP) / (1 + g_pop) - 1.

Q5 is NOMINAL USD and names EU-27. The model's market-rate GDP is at CONSTANT 2025 prices and exchange rates (it understates converging economies), and EU-27 is not a model region (oecd-ex-us also holds Japan, UK, Canada, Korea, Mexico, Turkiye, Australia). Only the real-growth leg of the US + China share is readable, and only directionally.

C2/Q2: the model's safe rate is a WORLD real rate on public debt under an HLW-type closure (r* = c x trend growth + z, plus a public-debt term, less any repression). It is not the NY Fed HLW estimate for the US, euro area or Canada and has no short-vs-long distinction. Use the sign and size of changes across runs.
